description: Movement-pattern slots, weekly minimums and slot templates. Spec: patterns-spec.md. Slot assignment and minimums are model choices, not measured.
count_unit: exercises per week: each tile on the board whose exercise lists the slot counts 1 (sets are not counted). A compound slot is only counted by non-isolation exercises. A slot with counts_toward also counts for those slots.

horizontal_push.name: Horizontal push
horizontal_push.description: Press away from your chest (bench, push-up, dip): your main chest and triceps builder.

vertical_push.name: Vertical push
vertical_push.description: Press overhead: front delts and triceps; horizontal pressing already covers much of this, so it is recommended, not required.

horizontal_pull.name: Horizontal pull
horizontal_pull.description: Row toward your torso: upper back thickness and rear delts.

vertical_pull.name: Vertical pull
vertical_pull.description: Pull down from overhead (pulldown, pull-up): your main lat builder.

squat.name: Squat (knee-dominant)
squat.description: Bend knees and hips together under load (squat, leg press, hack): the main quad builder.

hinge.name: Hinge
hinge.description: Bend at the hips with soft knees (RDL, deadlift): hamstrings, glutes and back.

lunge.name: Lunge / single-leg
lunge.description: One leg at a time (split squat, lunge, step-up); optional, and it also counts as a squat.

carry_core.name: Carry / anti-rotation
carry_core.description: Hold load while staying upright (carries, Pallof press, get-up); optional trunk and grip work.

power.name: Jump / throw
power.description: Fast, explosive reps (jumps, slams); optional athletic work, not a muscle builder.

chest_fly.name: Chest fly
chest_fly.description: Arms sweep together (fly, pec deck): chest work without triceps fatigue.

front_delts.name: Front delts
front_delts.description: Raise or angled press to the front; optional, since pressing already trains front delts.

side_delts.name: Side delts
side_delts.description: Raise out to the side: the main way to build shoulder width; presses barely reach it.

rear_delts.name: Rear delts
rear_delts.description: Pull the arms back and apart (reverse fly, face pull): back of the shoulder.

lat_iso.name: Lat isolation
lat_iso.description: Straight-arm pulldown or pullover: lats without biceps; optional.

traps.name: Traps
traps.description: Shrug: upper traps; optional, since heavy pulls and carries train them too.

biceps.name: Biceps
biceps.description: Bend the elbow against load (curls): rows and pulldowns help but rarely max them out.

triceps.name: Triceps
triceps.description: Straighten the elbow (pushdown, overhead extension); overhead versions stretch the long head.

forearms.name: Grip / forearms
forearms.description: Wrist curls, reverse curls and hangs; optional.

quads_iso.name: Quad isolation
quads_iso.description: Leg extension and similar: extra quad work with little back or hip fatigue.

hamstring_curl.name: Hamstring curl
hamstring_curl.description: Bend the knee against load: trains the hamstrings at the knee, which hinges do not fully cover.

glute_iso.name: Glute / hip extension
glute_iso.description: Hip thrust, back extension, kickback: extra glutes; optional.

hip_iso.name: Hip ad/abduction
hip_iso.description: Inner and outer thigh machines or cables; optional.

calves.name: Calves
calves.description: Calf raise: calves get little from squats, so they need their own work.

abs.name: Abs
abs.description: Crunch, leg raise or rollout: direct trunk flexion and bracing.

scoring._note: slot_recommendations score (model choice). score = w_fit*fit + w_similarity*swap.json score vs slot anchor/100 + w_main_slot*(slot is the exercise's first pattern) + w_staple*(in rules.staples) + w_use*min(preset tiles using it,12) - fatigue_penalty_by_level[level]*fatigue (+ beginner_machine_bonus for machine/cable families at beginner, + board_equipment_bonus if the board already uses that equipment, - already_on_board_penalty). fit = weighted mean of the exercise's ratings for slot.primary_muscles using muscle_weights. anchor = the slot's most-used preset exercise. Ties by id. Beginner excludes advanced_only and rare equipment (rings, suspension, medicine ball, stability ball); intermediate excludes rare equipment unless a staple.

templates_note: templates[split_id].levels[level][day_count] = [{day,label,slots:[{slot,sets,type}]}]. Derived from splits.json presets (same days, order, sets); `type` is a hint for which recommendation to pick (primary/accessory/isolation). Slots added to meet weekly_min_by_level are listed in templates_added.

custom_suggest.note: Muscle similarity picks the family; the name decides direction (pattern = line of pull/push, not leading muscle).
